title: If no more
html_source:
Stephen appears to agree with the Aristotelian (Western?) view but leaves open the possibility of alternatives. What can we directly know beyond our senses? Is spiritual insight possible?

A premonition of the Aristotle versus Plato thread to his Hamlet rant in the “Scylla and Charybdis” chapter.
